about: Test vectors for the Inbox relay's keys and envelope (adr/implementation/inbox-mobile.md, section 4), from all-zero inputs. packages/core/crypto.test.ts checks them in TypeScript; the iPhone app's tests (M5, M6) check the same file in Swift. `envelopes` are sealed under `derived.key` (down: items and pushes), `up_envelopes` under `derived.up_key` (commands). Public by design: nothing here protects anything.
